verdict.rationale: Digits' pricing page explicitly says it generates real-time profit & loss, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements. The API reference documents on-demand endpoints for balance sheet, cash flow, and P&L, and Digits Financials produces customizable statements directly from the ledger. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that statements can be run for any arbitrary date range, and independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy beyond vendor claims like 95%+ auto-booking and quality checks.
